Bombay High Court Denies Bail in Granddaughter's Drowning Case

The Bombay High Court denied bail to a man accused of drowning his granddaughter, stating it is "unfortunate" that some people still prefer male children. The court observed this while hearing the bail plea of the accused. The specific details of the incident, including the date and location, were not provided in the coverage. The court's remarks highlight a societal preference for male heirs, which it deemed regrettable.
